entry.title: New: dsh-bill
entry.summary: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool. Exact install spec: dsh-bill. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
